submission.justification: Recommend Radiator-R3 at 2.5 cm. R3 is one of the listed candidate radiators and is the humidity-tolerant porous option because candidate_specs.md identifies it as having a hydrophobic treatment. The lower-index solid R2 does not reach the required 3.5 sigma separation in the simulated 1--6 cm range, while untreated porous R1 gives higher raw separation but is not the humidity-qualified choice. For R3, the simulation scan shows a broad optimum around 2.5--3.5 cm; repeated 2.5 cm simulations gave 3.803--3.999 sigma, with an average about 3.90 sigma, comfortably above the 3.5 sigma hard requirement and at the best sampled feasible point.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: For the humidity-qualified radiator R3, the best sampled point was 2.5 cm: repeated simulations returned 3.999, 3.797, 3.998, and 3.803 sigma, averaging about 3.90 sigma. Nearby R3 points were comparable but not better on average; R2 never reached 3.5 sigma in the sampled 1--6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Radiator-R3 as one of the three candidate radiators.

requirements.requirement: The pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma.
requirements.evidence: Geant4 simulation for Radiator-R3 at 2.5 cm returned 3.803--3.999 sigma in repeated 100000-event runs, above the 3.5 sigma threshold.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 is specified in candidate_specs.md as the porous radiator with hydrophobic treatment; this is the option selected to satisfy the humidity-ageing hard requirement. Operation is also in a dry nitrogen-flushed vessel per gas_volume.md.
The selected thickness is 2.5 cm, within the allowed 1--6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Radiator-R3 at 2.5 cm.
